styleSelection.reason: Requested urban sketch, pen plus light wash: the pen carries the buildings, cypress, pine limbs and the edges of the tree masses; the village, terraces and cypress stay pale flat urban-sketch washes.

SF.foliage-centre.reason: large olive and pine masses: built light to dark in graded layers, so the lit yellow-green and the shaded greens separate instead of one flat olive wash

SF.foliage-left.reason: olive crowns and ground: graded layers, one connected mass per crown

SF.foliage-low.reason: mid green clumps along the bottom: graded layers

SF.pine.reason: bright yellow-green pine crown must stay light against the darker olives; layers built light to dark
